landing.title: The Subsonic API, Served From A WebDAV Library
landing.subtitle: Point any Subsonic client at this server and browse music you already have on WebDAV. No Transcoding, No Separate Library To Maintain.
landing.signInDidNothing: That navigation returned here without a session. Check That A Cloudflare Access Application Covers {{path}}, And That The Worker Has {{aud}} And {{team}} Set.
landing.subsonicApiDescription: Full Subsonic 1.16.1. Every Client You Already Have Signs In And Browses.
landing.webdavOriginDescription: Nextcloud, ownCloud, Or Anything Answering PROPFIND. Your Files Never Leave Home.
landing.edgeIndexDescription: Indexed In D1 And Read By Ranged Requests. No Server Holds Your Audio.

unauthorized.title: Access required
unauthorized.defaultMessage: You must authenticate to access this page.

libraries.title: Music libraries
libraries.hint: A library is a WebDAV origin plus a folder inside it. Subsonic clients see each library as a music folder.
libraries.emptyHint: Register a WebDAV origin to give Subsonic clients something to browse.
libraries.scanStalled: Stopped retrying. Fix the cause, then rescan.
libraries.stale: Showing the last known state — the most recent update could not be read.
libraries.scanPausedRequests: Paused at the per-chunk request limit. Raise SCAN_CHUNK_MAX_REQUESTS to index more per poll.
libraries.scanPausedDeadline: Paused at the per-chunk time limit. Raise SCAN_CHUNK_DEADLINE_MS, or expect more polls.

users.title: Subsonic users
users.hint: Point a Subsonic client at this server and sign in with one of these usernames. Passwords are stored encrypted and are never shown again.
users.emptyHint: Create an account, then sign in to this server from any Subsonic client.
